name: Contingent Injection
body:
Prerequisite: Heal 11 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you inject a creature with a pharmaceutical, poison, stimulant*, or other injection, you can delay the effect of the injection by up to 1 day. You may set some condition which causes the injection to activate on command. A creature can only have one contingent injection at any given time.
